messages:
anya: Quick FYI — Nimbus partner & GCP partner manager asked for quota pre-approval for a new region ap-southeast-4. They want marketplace quota and Dedicated capacity aligned before we go live.
praveen: Do we have expected baseline vs burst from Nimbus?
anya: They proposed initial reserved pool 24 Dedicated GPUs + 24 marketplace burst, total 48 A100-equivalent. Burst to 64 for up to 30 days if demand spikes.
jason_p: Clarify: reserved = Dedicated pool or marketplace commitment? Need to separate billing and routing.
anya: Nimbus wants 24 reserved (Dedicated) + 24 marketplace to seed listing; three-week ramp post-launch.
liam_r: Ops: I'll submit GCP quota request but need partner contact + official numbers. @anya paste the quota template.
anya: Using Nimbus template below — paste into GCP quota form:

Subject: Quota request - ap-southeast-4 - Redwood x Nimbus
Project: redwood-inference-marketplace
Region: ap-southeast-4
Requested resources:
  - GPUs (A100 80GB eq): 48
  - vCPUs: 1536
  - Reserved GPUs (Dedicated): 24
Requested start date: 2026-04-06
Reason: Marketplace listing + Dedicated pool for early enterprise customers.
Contact: anya@redwood.com, partner: daniel@nimbus.tech

susan_legal: If Nimbus is seller-of-record on GCP marketplace we'll need reseller addendum, SOW, indemnity checklist before listing goes public.
anya: Nimbus proposes to be seller-of-record. @susan_legal please advise SLA flow.
susan_legal: I'll draft reseller addendum and SOW this week. No blockers but need signatures pre-public.
praveen: Timeline check: GCP soft quota responses take ~3-7 business days; capacity increases 10-14. Nimbus wants ~3-week launch — tight but possible if legal + infra run in parallel.
liam_r: Opening tracker for infra readiness: networking, VPC peering, image distribution in ap-southeast-4. Assigning eng-platform.
eng-bot: New ticket INFRA-8342 created — ap-southeast-4 marketplace readiness. Assignee: @leo_platform
leo_platform: Acknowledged. I'll inventory region SKUs and image availability. ETA EOD tomorrow.
anya: Need marketplace SKU for pricing page. Nimbus sent provisional SKU; jason please confirm final SKU and mapping to our billing metrics.
jason_p: Send SKU spreadsheet and I'll update pricing page. Also schedule partner finance sync.
anya: Partner finance call Thu 10am PT with Nimbus + GCP partner manager. Invite sent.
praveen: Ops checklist:
- Quota request (liam)
- Reseller addendum (susan)
- Marketplace SKU + pricing (jason)
- Infra + images (leo)
- Console routing & fallback (eng-runtime)
- Joint announcement timeline (marketing)

maria_marketing: We'll draft the PR timeline and embargo suggestions. Need logos and co-marketing agreement from Nimbus.
praveen: Security/compliance — confirm if ap-southeast-4 is in our SOC2 scope; if not, add FAQ to listing about data residency.
susan_legal: We'll add compliance note and offer Private deployment options for regulated customers.
liam_r: Submitting quota now.
eng-bot: Quota request QREQ-202603-4578 submitted to GCP. Expect response 3-10 business days.
anya: Thanks all. @daniel please confirm final SKU and dedicated/marketplace split.
daniel@nimbus.tech: Confirmed. Uploading SKU spreadsheet by EOD and will sign SOW when draft received.
anya: I'll close thread when QREQ accepted. :thumbsup:
